A useful shortlist.
Not a blanket guarantee.

Only device brands with a documented physical-device or product-family list appear in this directory. Software tools and entries without device lists are excluded. Omitted brands may still be compatible; they need source review before inclusion.

Some options need extra hardware, a subscription, an account, internet access or technical review. Devices marked for a Zigbee bridge require that bridge and a compatible coordinator; their listing does not imply direct compatibility with every Zigbee setup. Availability and maintenance can change. Verify the exact model and requirements before purchase or installation.

What’s included in this directory?

This directory shows 615 device brands with 6,684 sourced device or product-family listings. A brand appears only after a device list is documented. Software tools, services and entries without a device list are hidden. This is a sourced subset, not an exhaustive list of all supported brands or every product a manufacturer makes.

This is a growing, source-backed subset—not every device a manufacturer makes. Lists can include regional products or named device families rather than exact models. Device features, firmware, connection method and availability in Canada must still be checked.

    Dashboard catalog scope.

    Includes every repository in the default HACS Dashboard category (called “plugin” in its data sources). Also includes a researched selection of independently published dashboard projects outside that default list. There is no complete registry of independent projects, so that selection is not exhaustive. Themes and backend integrations are not included. Descriptions, releases, stars and update dates reflect the metadata snapshot and may change.

    Snapshot provenance

    Sources: hacs/default plugin list and HACS Data plugin metadata. Source identifiers are shown as plain text; this export contains no outbound links.
